x: Surrey AC retained the team title thanks to storming runs by Dave Gibson and John Snowden on the last two laps. Once again the time-keeping was suspect and several of the times were shuffled about--in one report Tony Fairclough was credited with third fastest time!

Nobody could have forecast the winner with any certainty with only one lap remaining but 220 yards out Thresher struck out for home, reaching the tape fractionally ahead of Tim Johnston (Ports) and the ex-holder Dave Gibson (Surrey).
